Even though Mac shipments fell 11% in the third quarter of 2026, Apple's market share still rose from 8.5% to 9.5%, as overall market shipments dropped sharply by 20.1%, according to the latest IDC report. Here are the details.

Apple outperformed most of the PC market in a challenging environment

IDC released its global PC shipment report for the third quarter of 2026 today, noting that although Mac shipments decreased compared to the same period last year, Apple clearly outperformed the overall market.

According to IDC's preliminary data, Apple shipped 5.9 million Macs in the third quarter of 2026, down 11.3% from 6.7 million in the same period last year.

However, the overall PC market declined more significantly, with global shipments falling 20.1% year-on-year to 62.7 million units.

As a result, Apple's share of global PC shipments actually rose from 8.5% to 9.5%.

This allows Apple to firmly hold on to fourth place, with the top three being: Lenovo at the top with 14.9 million shipments and a 23.8% market share; HP with 10.3 million shipments and a 16.5% market share; Dell with 7.6 million shipments and a 12.1% market share.

Among the top five brands, HP had the largest year-on-year decline, with shipments falling 30.9%. ASUS had the smallest decline, down 8.6% year-on-year, with 5.5 million shipments and an 8.7% market share.
